feel: Reduced textures, standard brightness, 125 fps cap

provenance.changes: 113 of 321 lines were left out: chat lines, passwords and logins, the player’s name, file paths and hardware details, server hosting settings, timed key macros, settings of other games, settings the game protects, scripts that need other files, lines that close the game and lines the game can’t read.

story: configs.eu lists this file under TEK9. The hardware it names suggests 2005 to 2008; the page gives no date. Sensitivity can’t be compared between players without the mouse’s DPI, which the file doesn’t give.
